training.architecture: hashed word/character n-grams + linear softmax, int8 weights
training.provenance: Assistant-authored English examples with simple prefix/suffix augmentation. No external teacher model. Evaluation phrases were authored separately before training. English only; unrelated, ambiguous, multiple-intent and unsupported-language requests should fall back.

calibration.note: Thresholds selected on this small authored calibration set; not a statistical safety guarantee.
